### A Light in the Dark
Author: Samantha Evilsizer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/a-light-in-the-dark-encouragement-for-today-december-25-2013.html
Passage: Luke 2:30-32
Points:
- Earthly remedies, well-meaning help, and changes in setting cannot heal deep grief or spiritual pain.
- Like Simeon, believers are reminded that true salvation and lasting rescue come only through Jesus Christ.
- Simeon was defined by a focused passion to see God's promised Messiah with his own eyes.
- Looking to Jesus provides divine light, peace, and hope even in life's darkest situations.

### Will You See The Lord's Christ this Christmas?
Author: Mike Pohlman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-dec-11-2008-11596812.html
Passage: Luke 2:29-32
Points:
- Simeon was an ordinary layman rather than an official priest, yet he demonstrated extraordinary devotion.
- He waited expectantly for redemption because his hope was anchored in God's scriptural promises.
- Beholding the infant Savior gave Simeon full peace, knowing God's salvation had arrived for all people.
- How an individual responds to Jesus exposes their true heart and determines their eternal destiny.
